What's new?

As of today, your mail icon will light up (show as red) in realtime when you receive a new notification (private message or a post/comment reply).

How does this work?

Your browser will keep a live connection with Voat server using ASP.NET SignalR library. Voat server will send your browser a push notification as soon as someone replies to one of your comments/posts or sends you a private message.

How did this work before?

Users needed to refresh the page manually in order for the new mail icon to light up.

Please leave a comment and report any issues you may find with this feature or simply tell us how much you love it :)
